pets.name: Phoenix

methods.name: Wintertodt reward cart
methods.source: OSRS Wiki: 1/5,000 per reward roll. 500 points gives 2 rolls; every further 500 points adds one roll; points between those thresholds are a linear extra-roll chance. Supply crates became reward-cart searches on 9 October 2024, with the same per-roll rate. Hiscores Wintertodt score is subdues, not rolls.

methods.name: 200 million Firemaking
methods.source: OSRS Wiki: at 200 million Firemaking XP the phoenix is 15 times more common, so the roll rate is 1/5,000 divided by 15.

pets.notes: 5,504 rewards claimed; 2,425 Wintertodt kills. In-game collection-log screenshot supplied by the account owner on 5 October 2026.

methods.name: Chambers of Xeric unique
methods.source: OSRS Wiki: 1/53 when a unique is received. Unique chance is 1% per 8,676 team points, capped at 65.7% at 570,000 points; further points roll another unique. A 26,025-point raid is about 1/1,765 from that formula, not this account's rate. Hiscores raid count is not a unique count.

methods.name: Challenge Mode unique
methods.source: OSRS Wiki: 1/53 when a unique is received. Unique chance is 1% per 8,676 team points, capped at 65.7% at 570,000 points; further points roll another unique. A 26,025-point raid is about 1/1,765 from that formula, not this account's rate. Hiscores raid count is not a unique count. Challenge Mode changes how often a unique is rolled, not the 1/53 pet chance.
